adapter.title: FTP / FTPS
adapter.description: Sync files from an FTP or FTPS server.
adapter.instructions: Enter the FTP folder URL and choose the server’s security mode. Use explicit or implicit TLS when available.
field.allowPlaintext: Allow sending credentials and files without encryption
field.trustedCertificateSha256: TLS certificate SHA-256 fingerprint (optional, 64 hex digits)
